about: Scheduled events by the Indian session they affect, 2025-09-01 to 2026-12-31. Every date was read on the page in its source on 2026-11-28; a date that could not be read on a page is left out, never filled from memory. An FOMC decision is announced at 14:00 New York, after the Indian close, so it is stored on the next Indian weekday and its title says so.
